sql:
SELECT 
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as trips_count,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  AVG(yt) as avg_yt_per_trip,
  MAX(yt) as max_yt,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers
FROM trips
WHERE fished_date_season = 1
GROUP BY cls
ORDER BY total_yt DESC
